content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions are rampant, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-first-principles|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators are locked out of conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-works-how-3|How Payment]]-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-11|payment]] systems like Stripe and PayPal, rendering them unable to sell their digital products. This infrastructure problem is precisely what COREMERCH solves with its sovereign digital commerce stacks, designed for creators in restricted regions to deploy their own online stores with automatic crypto payment processing and full data ownership.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure works because it bypasses traditional payment platforms altogether, leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This approach ensures that creators maintain full ownership and control over their stores and customer data, without relying on third-party services that might restrict their access due to geographical or political reasons. With this setup, creators can sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products directly to their customers, regardless of where they are in the world.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to decide between Stack 01 and Stack 02, each offering different levels of complexity and functionality. Stack 01, which can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, ideal for creators with basic needs. On the other hand, Stack 02, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offering more advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for enhanced email deliverability and end-to-end testing for a smoother customer experience. Understanding your needs and the capabilities of each stack is crucial for a successful deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments into your stack, which allows for the acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction. You will also need to configure your digital product delivery system, which can be as simple as using Google Drive or as robust as Cloudflare R2, depending on your stack choice. Ensuring a seamless payment and delivery process is key to customer satisfaction and repeat business. By leveraging the right tools and following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can create a highly efficient and automated sales process that requires minimal intervention once set up.
Deploy a digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed and configured, going live involves making your store accessible to the public and testing your payment and delivery pipeline with a small transaction. This step is crucial as it ensures that everything works as expected before you start promoting your store. With Stack 02, this process is more streamlined since it comes end-to-end tested by COREMERCH, but for Stack 01, following the deployment guide carefully and testing thoroughly is essential. The moment your first transaction is successfully processed, you know your infrastructure is working, and you can start scaling your business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your digital store involves increasing your product offerings, improving your marketing efforts, and possibly upgrading your infrastructure to handle more traffic and sales. The Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, is invaluable for this phase, providing you with the tools and knowledge needed to expand your operations efficiently. Whether you're adding more digital products, exploring new markets, or optimizing your store for better performance, having a solid infrastructure foundation like the one provided by COREMERCH ensures that your growth is sustainable and profitable. By focusing on scaling, you can turn your digital store into a thriving business that generates significant revenue and grows your customer base consistently.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can deploy Stack 01, which includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your store, manage backend logic, and accept cryptocurrency payments with minimal fees. By following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can have your store up and running in 4-6 hours, giving you a quick and cost-effective way to start selling digital products without relying on restricted platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
Scale your business with the Complete Builder Kit, including all blueprints and templates.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to deploy a digital store quickly and efficiently, COREMERCH offers the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates for building, deploying, and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can find more information about this and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit is especially useful for those who want to dive deeper into the world of digital commerce and explore more advanced features and configurations for their stores.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by choosing between Stack 01 and Stack 02 based on your needs. Next, set up your hosting with either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, configure your backend logic using Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. After that, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Ensure you have a delivery system in place, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your store thoroughly, including a small transaction to verify that payments and deliveries are working as expected. Finally, promote your store and start selling your digital products to a global audience.
